name: Dakkon Blackblade
description: A warrior and master blacksmith who became a planeswalker after forging a soul-drinking sword for Geyadrone Dihada, who then betrayed him.

description_citations.text: "Dakkon Blackblade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dakkon forges the Blackblade, sacrificing his own blood, then his son Daron, then countless slaves over the following years.
timeline.quote: Dakkon plunged the white-hot metal into his own son's chest.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone receives the Blackblade and steals Dakkon's soul by stabbing his shadow with the sword.
timeline.quote: she stabbed Dakkon's shadow on the ground, treacherously stealing his soul with the sword

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon stabs Piru with the Blackblade, killing her; the blast creates the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor and Dihada absorbs Piru's soul power.
timeline.quote: he stabbed Piru with the Blackblade, killing her.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada binds Dakkon to her will and he travels to Terisiare with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Dihada managed to "tag" Dakkon, binding him to her will.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon fights Chromium and Piru for Dihada; Chromium drains Dakkon, who teleports him away and then kills Piru with the Black Blade.
timeline.quote: Dakkon was reunited with the Black Blade and used it to kill the dragon

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Serving Dihada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around the New Phyrexian Invasion Corondor falls under Geyadrone Dihada's control again.
timeline.quote: the island fell back under the control of Geyadrone Dihada

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada offers to make Dakkon a planeswalker if he forges the Blackblade, and he forges it over ten years, killing a slave with it each time.
timeline.quote: offered to make him a planeswalker if he would make her the most powerful blade in existence, the Blackblade .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Forging the Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon becomes Dakkon Blackblade through his slaughter; Dihada ignites his spark but stabs the sword into his shadow and binds his soul into the blade.
timeline.quote: she stabbed the sword into Dakkon's shadow and absorbed his soul but not his life.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Forging the Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Son of Carth escapes Dihada's dungeons and uses the Amulet of Ti-Fu to bind himself to Dakkon.
timeline.quote: The boy (known as the Son of Carth ) used the Amulet of Ti-Fu to bind himself to Dakkon

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar, banishes Chromium and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
timeline.quote: This released a massive energy blast that created the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada reveals the monk was herself, absorbs Piru's soul, and her glyph steals Dakkon's spark and binds him to her for eternity.
timeline.quote: She then revealed to Carth that the monk who had set Carth on his quest was none other than Dihada herself.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon and the boy travel to Terisiare, where the boy starts the Carthalion legacy.
timeline.quote: the boy started the Carthalion legacy, named after Dakkon's nickname for the boy, "Carth the Lion".

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Bound to Dihada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Piru is killed by Dakkon Blackblade in ages past.
timeline.quote: Piru was largely forgotten after she was killed by Dakkon Blackblade in ages past

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Elder Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada has Dakkon forge the Blackblade, then triggers his spark and absorbs his soul into it.
timeline.quote: but then she used the Blackblade to absorb his shadow and his soul into the blade.

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada tricks a boy into summoning and binding Dakkon, robbing him of planeswalking.
timeline.quote: This effectively robbed Dakkon of his planeswalking ability

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon kills Piru in a blast that creates the Dueling Chasm; Dihada absorbs the dragon's power and marks Dakkon.
timeline.quote: Dakkon killed Piru in a blast so powerful that it ripped the group apart

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon defeats Sol'Kanar, whom Dihada then discards as she tricks Dakkon into becoming her champion.
timeline.quote: He was defeated by Dakkon

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Minion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The timeline places the Dragon War story in the Time of Legends.
timeline.quote: The Dragon War

citation.text: "Timeline/Sourced", section "Time of Legends (c. -5000 AR to 0 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon Blackblade boasts of his power in his Memoirs.
timeline.quote: "My power is as vast as the plains; my strength is that of mountains.

citation.text: Dakkon Blackblade (Chronicles, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ravidel's summoning backfires, a sinkhole forms under Hamath, and he plunges into the abyss while Dakkon routs his forces; he is assumed dead.
timeline.quote: Ravidel was not heard from again and was assumed to be dead.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina reappears, having lost her planeswalker spark; she and Jared choose mortal lives and Jared accepts becoming Elder Druid.
timeline.quote: She had managed to escape the explosion but had lost her Planeswalker spark in the process.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel's first attack on Hamath is repulsed with Freyalise and Dakkon's help.
timeline.quote: Thus, Ravidel's initial attack on Hamath is repulsed.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared becomes the next Elder Druid, giving up planeswalkerhood.
timeline.quote: Jared acknowledges his destiny and becomes the next Elder Druid, willingly giving up his planeswalkerhood.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon is subjugated by demonic forces.
timeline.quote: Before he was subjugated by demonic forces, Dakkon was a master smith of unrivaled artistry.

citation.text: Blacksmith's Skill (Modern Horizons 2, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dakkon forges the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada and unwittingly becomes part of her schemes.
timeline.quote: As Dakkon forged the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada, he unwittingly forged himself into her schemes.

citation.text: Profane Tutor (Modern Horizons 2, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The boy summons Dakkon, who is bound by the Amulet from killing him until Dihada is slain.
timeline.quote: When the boy summoned him, Dakkon was far from pleased.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a skirmish with Dihada nearly kills the boy, Dakkon saves him and they become friends.
timeline.quote: Dakkon intervened to save him, and an unlikely friendship grew between them.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada returns with Sol'Kanar and two Elder Dragons; Dakkon slays Sol'Kanar and banishes Chromium.
timeline.quote: Dakkon slew Sol’Kanar and banished Chromium

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The boy recovers the Blackblade and passes it to Dakkon, who uses it to kill Piru.
timeline.quote: Dakkon used the blade to kill Piru.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that Dihada, disguised as the Mad Monk, orchestrated everything; she absorbs Piru's energy and seals Dakkon to her will.
timeline.quote: She had been disguised as the Mad Monk who had first set the boy on his quest.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon and the boy leave for Terisiare, where the boy becomes ancestor of House Carthalion.
timeline.quote: Dakkon and the boy left for Terisiare

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada, sensing the Ember of Dakkon's unignited Spark, offers to make him a planeswalker if he forges her a soul-drinking sword.
timeline.quote: she offered to make him a Planeswalker if he would forge her a soul-drinking sword.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dakkon works for ten years forging the sword, quenching it in the blood of his slaves.
timeline.quote: for ten years he worked tirelessly, quenching the sword again and again in the blood of his slaves.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dihada returns to claim the finished sword and keeps her word, igniting Dakkon's Spark.
timeline.quote: She kept her word, igniting Dakkon’s Spark and unlocking his power as a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dihada betrays Dakkon by absorbing his shadow and soul into the blade.
timeline.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Carth summons Dakkon to Sedouris; Dihada destroys the city, and Dakkon regains his shadow but is enslaved to her.
timeline.quote: Dakkon regaining his shadow but also becoming enslaved to Dihada's will

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Summoned by Geyadrone Dihada to fight Dakkon Blackblade, Piru and Chromium face him; Dakkon's mind control on Rhuell fails.
timeline.quote: since Elder Dragons are nearly as powerful as planeswalkers, Dakkon failed

citation.text: "Piru", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon sends Rhuell away and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
timeline.quote: Piru then fought him but was killed when Dakkon stabbed her with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Piru", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada absorbs much of Piru's energy, having manipulated Dakkon into forging the Blackblade and killing Piru.
timeline.quote: Geyadrone Dihada absorbed much of Piru's energy and had planned the dragon's death all along

citation.text: "Piru", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Few remember the exploits of Dakkon's grandmother, Eunice Blackblade.

citation.text: Granny's Payback (Arena League 2004, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Bound to Dakkon through the amulet; they became allies against Dihada.
relations.quote: And serve he did, happily, when he learned of Carth's enemy, Dihada herself.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She betrayed him after he forged her sword.
relations.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
